sessionCookie.name: fw_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server session; Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict. Unsafe cookie methods require CSRF header and origin verification.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: opaque or validated OIDC access token
bearerAuth.description: Bound issuer/audience/project and capability. ID token is not API bearer.

mutualTLS.description: Pinned service identity and independent scope authorization.

NativeInstallationManifest.description: Runtime evidence, not approval content. Persistent deny has expires_at=null and bound_timeout_seconds=0. Allow bound_timeout_seconds never exceeds remaining signed absolute lifetime.

ReadbackReport.description: match additionally requires expected_state_hash==observed_semantic_hash under expiry-aware semantic validator. Raw readback is separate immutable evidence.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Binds exact canonical body, route, principal and tenant. Same key with different body returns409.

CSRF.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRF.description: Mandatory for unsafe cookie sessions; never an authorization substitute.
